in_sanskrit.name: नारेशकुमार
in_sanskrit.meaning: Lord of the Man (Naara) and God (Ishvara) or God of the People (Nara + Raja + Kumar)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the Lord of the Man (Naara) and God (Ishvara), or the God of the People (Nara + Raja + Kumar).

in_marathi.name: Nareshkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth, God of Courage
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nareshkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nareshkumar is a combination of two Sanskrit words: Naresh (Lord of the Earth) and Kumar (God of Courage). This name is associated with strength, bravery, and divine protection. It is believed that Nareshkumar embodies the power of the earth and inspires courage in those who bear this name.
